children: Dubai, UAE, September 18th, 2026, FinanceWire

DB Investing today announced the launch of dbinvesting.ai, marking its evolution from a traditional brokerage into an AI-first fintech and technology company. After an extensive development program, it has built an AI Core Engine designed to work at 360 degrees — across trading, investing, education, market intelligence, portfolio analysis, customer experience and internal operations — not as a chatbot added to a platform.
From Broker to Technology Company

The industry has adopted the term “AI” rapidly, often for simple chatbots or basic tools. DB Investing has chosen a different direction: Executive AI — intelligence that understands data, accounts, trading behaviour, markets and user objectives, and works continuously alongside the trader. Not an “AI trading bot”, but an intelligent financial operating system.

“We do not believe that adding a chatbot to a website makes a financial company an AI company. We have spent a long time developing an infrastructure where AI becomes part of the company's core, its products, and eventually the entire customer experience. DB Investing is evolving from being only a broker into becoming a fintech and technology company.” Gennaro Lanza - CEO
Built to Work Beyond DB Investing

The technology is designed to work beyond the DB Investing ecosystem. A lightweight connector in the user’s trading environment will link compatible MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 accounts, including those at third-party brokers, so traders need not move their brokerage relationship. Eligible users receive monthly AI credits; advanced users can connect supported AI services with their own API credentials, subject to platform and security requirements — keeping the AI layer independent and scalable.
TRADING ACCOUNT CONNECTION AND DATA INTEGRATION SUPPORT AI UNDERSTANDING
AI That Understands the Trader
Every trader is different: two traders in the same instrument on the same day can need completely different assistance. The AI is therefore being developed to understand:
Trading history, preferred instruments, holding periods, frequency, position sizing and historical performance; and
Risk behaviour, drawdowns, concentration, discipline, recurring mistakes and how behaviour changes over time.
The objective is an AI that progressively understands the individual behind the account.
Wealth Copilot: A 24/7 AI Agent for Traders and Investors
Within the coming weeks, DB Investing plans to release Wealth Copilot, a 24/7 AI agent combining trading activity with market intelligence and portfolio context to identify:
Important account changes, unusual risk exposure, concentration and risk-management observations; and
Behavioural and performance patterns, plus economic events and news relevant to open positions.

Rather than the trader searching across terminals, calendars, news sites and statements, Wealth Copilot organises that information around the individual. It does not replace the investor’s decisions; it helps them decide better.
Introducing the AI Traders University

Traditional education gives thousands of students the same videos, whatever their behaviour in the market. The AI Traders University is instead built around an AI trading mentor that analyses how each trader actually trades — showing whether they consistently:
Enter too late, increase size after losses, or close winners early and let losers run;
Overtrade, trade excessively in volatile periods, or ignore their own risk rules; and
Concentrate capital in correlated markets, repeating the same behavioural mistakes.
TRADITIONAL MODEL - “Here is a trading course.”
AI-NATIVE MODEL - “Here is what you specifically need to improve.”
The ambition is an evolving link between education, real trading behaviour and measurable improvement.
Building an AI Ecosystem, Not a Single Product
dbinvesting.ai is the foundation, not the final product. The roadmap envisions an interconnected ecosystem combining:
AI Wealth Copilot
AI Traders University
Trading Behaviour Intelligence
Market Intelligence
Portfolio Analytics
Risk Intelligence
Trading Account Connectivity
Personalised Education
AI Financial Assistants
All of these can ultimately run on the same AI Core Engine, with AI embedded in customer-facing products and internal operations alike.
The Beginning of a Different Kind of Brokerage

DB Investing believes the next generation of financial companies will not compete on spreads, leverage, platforms or instrument counts alone — technology will become part of the customer relationship. The company positions itself at the intersection of Brokerage + Fintech + AI + Financial Education + Market Intelligence, and dbinvesting.ai is the first visible stage of that strategy.

“This is not a feature that we are adding to DB Investing. It is the beginning of changing what DB Investing is. Our objective is to build an AI infrastructure capable of sitting beside every trader and investor, understanding their behaviour, helping them learn and giving them access to intelligence that historically required several different platforms and tools.” - Gennaro Lanza - CEO
Traders and investors can explore dbinvesting.ai and open an account at dbinvesting.com
About DB Investing

DB Investing is an international financial services and trading brand that provides access to global markets while developing a new generation of fintech, AI, and trading technology. Through dbinvesting.ai it is building an AI-powered ecosystem connecting trading, investing, market intelligence, education and personalised financial technology.
